summary: About two thirds of long-tenured laid-off workers are working again by the survey date.
realLife: The survey found 66 percent reemployed, 18 percent unemployed and 16 percent out of the labor force; for ages 55 to 64 reemployment was 57 percent and for 65 and older 39 percent. About half of reemployed full-time workers earned as much or more than before.
sources: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Worker Displacement news release (Jan 2023 to Dec 2025): https://www.bls.gov/news.release/disp.nr0.htm
inGame: Follows the job-ended event: a later hire in the jobs module with a new pay; age is on the person. Targets should come from the simulation, not these figures, which only suggest direction.
